About the episode 
Ryan Carniato tells us all about SolidJS, a declarative, efficient, and flexible JavaScript library for building user interfaces. 

NOTE: This is the video recording of the podcast. You can listen to the audio-only version of the episode at https://podrocket.logrocket.com or wherever you get your podcasts.
